description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Complaint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Refund"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Files complaint" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Notifies customer of decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Refund" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provides feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDetails" name="Review complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateComplaint" name="Determine validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyDecision" name="Notify customer of decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" name="Merge resolution paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Resolved" name="Complaint resolved"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Customer provides feedback">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Feedback" name="Feedback received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateComplaint" targetRef="Task_NotifyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_Resolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="End_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
